voiceTapTitle: Recording: say it, then tap Next step
voiceBlocked: The microphone could not be used. Allow the microphone for this page, or add an audio file instead.
voiceUnsupported: This browser cannot record from the microphone. Add an audio file instead.
voiceReadFailed: That audio could not be read. Try an MP3, M4A or WAV file.
voiceFit: Spread the steps to fit the voice
voiceNoSound: This browser cannot put sound into the video. The video will be made without it. You can add your voice in your editing app.
fourKHint: 4K needs a recent computer or phone and takes the longest. The file is large.
keepOpenSmooth: Drawing every frame: {done}% done, about {left} seconds left. Keep this screen on and stay on this page.
keepOpen: Keep this screen on and stay on this page while the video records. It takes as long as the video.
smoothNote: Saved as an MP4 file with every frame drawn, at 30 frames a second.
webmNote: This browser saves WebM video. It plays in Chrome, Edge and Firefox. If an app does not accept it, open this page in Chrome on a computer or a recent Android phone and save again.
noRecord: This browser cannot record video. You can still preview and save a picture. Try a recent Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox to make the video.
failed: The video could not be made. Try 720p or fewer steps, and keep this page open while it records.
voiceHint: Record your voice while you tap through the screens, so each screen changes when you say it. Or add an audio file you already have. Your voice stays on your device.
voiceReady: Tap Next step each time you move to the next screen. The video starts on your first tap.
voiceTimed: Voice added: {name}, {seconds} seconds. The screens change at the moments you tapped.
voiceFitted: Voice added: {name}, {seconds} seconds. The screens are spread to fit it.
voiceChanged: Voice added: {name}, {seconds} seconds. You changed the screens after recording, so they are spread to fit the voice.
empty: Add your screenshots, or tap Use sample screens to see how it looks.
tip: Tip: save the video, then drop it into Instagram Edits, CapCut or InShot. If you added your voice here, the sound is already in the file.
start: 1. Pick a starter and add your screens
startersHint: A starter sets the frame, look and style, and suggests a sentence for each screen. Add your screenshots, then tap Fill empty sentences.

frameHint.phone: Best for phone screenshots, which are tall.
frameHint.laptop: Best for website screenshots from a computer. Tall pages scroll.
frameHint.none: A plain rounded card, with no phone or laptop.

screensHint: Add up to {max} screenshots, in the order you want to show them. Take them on your phone or computer, or save them from a design tool. Very tall pages are scrolled for you.
tooMany: Only {max} screens are used. The extra ones were left out.
screenFailed: {name} could not be read. Try a PNG or JPG screenshot.
pointer: What a tap on the picture does

pointers.mark: Sets the spot to point at

pointerHint: Tap the small picture to place it. The orange dot is the spot you point at. The grey box hides private details such as a name or number.
pictureButton: Tap the picture to place the spot
more: More options: look, words, scrolling and speed
scrollHint: A screenshot much taller than the screen, such as a long page, glides from the top to the bottom.
notSaved: Your screenshots are not saved between visits, only your settings. Make the video before you leave the page.
helpItems: Add your screenshots in the order you want to show them, or tap Use sample screens to try it first.
Choose a Phone frame for phone screenshots or a Laptop frame for website screenshots. Tall pages scroll by themselves.
To point at something, tap the small picture where it is, then choose a tap circle, an arrow or a box. Turn on Zoom to move closer to that spot.
To hide a name, number or address, switch the tap to Sets the spot to hide, tap that part of the picture and turn on Hide private details. It is blurred into blocks in the video.
Write a short sentence for each screen, tap Play to watch it, then tap Make video. Add your voice if you like.
